### Coverage

- Online Training:
  - Online Training produces checkpoints, Full, Delta or Streaming snapshots
  - Oncall: [mrs_online_training](https://www.internalfb.com/omh/view/mrs_online_training)
- Recurring Training:
  - Recurring Training produces checkpoints
  - Oncall: [minimal_viable_ai](https://www.internalfb.com/omh/view/minimal_viable_ai)
- Publishing
  - Reads checkpoints produced by the training job and produces Full Snapshots
  - Online item embedding produces delta item embeddings in an online training job using ST Update Service
  - Oncall: [home_ml_platform](https://www.internalfb.com/omh/view/home_ml_platform) 
- Serving
  - Not in scope of this document
  - Oncall: [feed_ranking_infra](https://www.internalfb.com/omh/view/feed_ranking_infra)  
- Trunk Health
  - Metric Definition: Age since the last healthy revision
  - Oncall [mrs_ml_release_oncall](https://www.internalfb.com/omh/view/mrs_ml_release_oncall) 
- Defines SEV 1-3 for individual or a group of models
- This includes the model generation stability process established previously
### How to interpret the SEV criteria table

- SEV Criteria: “X% of all models in Tier-Y exceeding Z hours”.
- If a model leads to business impact on the product side before the criteria below, ML Infra will elevate the SEV to the required level matching the product impact 
  - eg. 1 Tier1 model causing 25% product impact will be treated as a SEV2

# SEV 1 Criteria

[Live Tier Info](https://www.internalfb.com/production_models/mrs?search=%7B%22key%22%3A%22MRS_PRODUCTION_MODEL_ROOT%22%2C%22children%22%3A[]%7D&columns=[%22model_id%22%2C%22model_type_name%22%2C%22snapshot_staleness%22%2C%22training_type%22%2C%22framework%22%2C%22inference_service%22%2C%22inference_hardware_type%22%2C%22px_criticality%22%2C%22qps%22%2C%22inference_gpu_count%22%2C%22inference_cpu_core_count%22%2C%22inference_mem_usage%22%2C%22owner_unixname%22%2C%22oncall_shortname%22]&sortby=%7B%22sortKey%22%3A%22qps%22%2C%22direction%22%3A%22descending%22%7D&mrs_usecase=VIDEO) for PG models


| **Area** | **Percentage** | **Tier** | **Impact Time** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Online & Recurring Training | > 90% | TIER-1 | > 24h |
| Trunk Health  | [MC delayed](https://www.internalfb.com/wiki/Feed-ranking/Feed_Metrics_Oncall_Runbook/#SEV-Criteria-)/MB/Cargo for >= 1 model | TIER-1 | 10 weeks |


# SEV 2 Criteria



| **Area** | **Percentage** | **Tier** | **Impact Time** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Online Training | > 25% | TIER-1 | > 12h |
| Recurring Training | > 25% | TIER-1 | > 24h |
| Trunk Health | [MC delayed](https://www.internalfb.com/wiki/Feed-ranking/Feed_Metrics_Oncall_Runbook/#SEV-Criteria-)/MB/Cargo for >= 1 model | TIER-1 | 2 weeks |
|  | 2 or more PG conveyors - no MC delayed | TIER-1 | 2 weeks |


# SEV 3 Criteria



| **Area** | **Percentage** | **Tier** | **Impact Time** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Online Training | > 10% of the models (at least 3 models impacted) | TIER-1 or TIER-2 | > 3h |
|  | > 50% | TIER-1 & TIER-2 | > 1.5h |
|  | 1 model | TIER-1 | > 3 full snapshot publishing cycles going stale and no DELTAs have been published in between |
| Recurring Training | > 25% | TIER-1 & TIER-2 | 8h |
|  | 1 model training | TIER-1 | [IFR Retrieval: >12h](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1_ipBLDeTJc9acNd1T_TeH2TbnvwhMiLReAuJBDq6KC4/edit?tab=t.0#heading=h.3rr9ezim8wm6) / [IFR Ranking: >12h](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1_ipBLDeTJc9acNd1T_TeH2TbnvwhMiLReAuJBDq6KC4/edit?tab=t.0#heading=h.3rr9ezim8wm6) / [CFR: >24h](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1W7IBL74x3DJ0y9ea7i7iwEHhoa8vjZVOAP70ZvvY2uk/edit?tab=t.0#heading=h.3rr9ezim8wm6) / [Video: >24h](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1p2mpjZCbQWK3u8KElURiBvOV7vGZ-vSmr79yOvUF5Qo/edit?tab=t.0#heading=h.3rr9ezim8wm6) |
|  | 1 model publishing | TIER-1 | [IFR Retrieval: >12h](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1_ipBLDeTJc9acNd1T_TeH2TbnvwhMiLReAuJBDq6KC4/edit?tab=t.0#heading=h.3rr9ezim8wm6) / [IFR Ranking: >24h](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1_ipBLDeTJc9acNd1T_TeH2TbnvwhMiLReAuJBDq6KC4/edit?tab=t.0#heading=h.3rr9ezim8wm6) / [CFR: >48h](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1W7IBL74x3DJ0y9ea7i7iwEHhoa8vjZVOAP70ZvvY2uk/edit?tab=t.0#heading=h.3rr9ezim8wm6) / [Video offline: >24h](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1p2mpjZCbQWK3u8KElURiBvOV7vGZ-vSmr79yOvUF5Qo/edit?tab=t.0#heading=h.3rr9ezim8wm6) |
| Trunk Health | Light_cli broken | TIER-1 | > 1 days |
|  | 1 IG conveyor | TIER-1 | > 2.25 days |
|  | 1 Discovery conveyor | TIER-1 | > 4 business days |
|  | 2 or more PG conveyors impacted by the same issue | TIER-1 | > 3 business days |
